queries_used.note: Tier 3 exceeded the cap of 8 by 3 lookups (process deviation). Tier 2 reached the cap after two follow-up calls made in response to review findings. One memory result (about 220,000 characters) was not read.

candidates.name: livekit-client

evidence.claim: npm view: version 2.24.1, license Apache-2.0, modified 2026-11-14.
Room.connect(url, token) with adaptiveStream and dynacast; ConnectionError exposes reason and status for a rejected token.
Team manifest assigns the RealtimeRoom port over livekit-client to webrtc-engineer.

risks: Not pinned in versions.toml; the operator must pin it.
The same bundle runs in the Tauri webview; desktop is unverified in this phase.
candidates.decision_rationale: Official browser SDK, already named by the team design. Lives behind the RealtimeRoom port in an infrastructure adapter.

candidates.name: @livekit/components-react

evidence.claim: npm view: version 2.9.25; peer react >=18, livekit-client ^2.20.1.
UI primitives come from the shared shadcn/ui set themed with the tokens; components are not copied per app.

risks: Prefab components carry their own styling and would diverge from the Know Meet design.
candidates.decision_rationale: Rejected as the UI layer. May be read for behaviour (track handling, device selection).

candidates.name: livekit-api (feature access-token)

evidence.claim: cargo info: default features are services, access-token, webhooks; access-token alone depends only on livekit-token.
AccessToken::with_api_key(..).with_identity(..).with_grants(VideoGrants{room_join, room, ..}).with_ttl(..).to_jwt(); default TTL is 6 hours.

risks: Version 0.x: the API may change between minor releases.
Default TTL is 6 hours; the service must set a short TTL explicitly.
Not pinned in versions.toml.
candidates.decision_rationale: Official Rust server SDK; the repo's services are Rust and Axum. Use default-features = false with access-token.

candidates.name: docs/design/live/server.mjs

evidence.claim: Mints HS256 tokens with roomJoin, canPublish and canPublishData; identity is a slug of the name plus random hex; response carries url, token, identity, room, expiresIn.
The token service in services/livekit supersedes docs/design/live/server.mjs.

risks: Frozen prototype code with no login; it must not be deployed.
candidates.decision_rationale: Behaviour reference for the new token endpoint.

candidates.name: livekit-server-sdk (Node)

evidence.claim: npm view: version 2.19.3, Apache-2.0.

candidates.decision_rationale: Would add a Node service runtime to a repo whose services are Rust.

candidates.name: LiveKit Cloud (existing KnowMe project)

evidence.claim: Recorded 2026-10-25: ~/.bash_profile has the three LIVEKIT_ settings, the URL points to a LiveKit Cloud project, listing rooms succeeded.
Recorded 2026-10-19: the same three variables are set; values were not printed.

risks: Not re-verified in this session.
Usage is billed; a public token endpoint exposes that cost.
Whether this project is the production project is unconfirmed.
candidates.decision_rationale: No media server, UDP firewall or TURN to operate. Pending operator confirmation (A2).

candidates.name: Self-hosted LiveKit on GKE

evidence.claim: The conduit deploy creates a livekit-webrtc firewall rule targeting node tags and carries k8s/livekit and k8s/lk-jwt-service.
The target cluster has 2 nodes of unrecorded size.

candidates.decision_rationale: Operational cost is out of proportion for a first release on a two-node cluster.

candidates.name: static-web-server

evidence.claim: gh api: latest release v2.44.2 published 2026-11-12; Apache-2.0; pushed 2026-11-14.

page-fallback (env SERVER_FALLBACK_PAGE) serves an HTML file with status 200 for missing paths and keeps 404 for missing assets; default port 8080; custom headers per glob in [[advanced.headers]]; a health endpoint exists.

risks: Only the SPDX id reported by the GitHub API was read; the licence file itself was not.
Not exercised with this bundle yet; deep-link behaviour is proven only by the hosted check.
candidates.decision_rationale: The bundle is static files. A server with no application code is the smallest internet-facing surface.

candidates.name: services/bff made deployable

evidence.claim: Binds loopback, allows only loopback Host values, serves an unauthenticated notes API on one SQLite file, and has no SPA fallback.

candidates.decision_rationale: Built for the local desktop case. Stays unchanged for desktop and local development.

candidates.name: GitHub Container Registry

evidence.claim: Organisation images are published as ghcr.io/know-me-tools/*, pushed with the workflow token.
gh repo view: visibility PUBLIC, default branch main.

risks: Packages must be made public by the operator, or the cluster needs a pull secret.
candidates.decision_rationale: Organisation precedent; no new cloud IAM.

candidates.name: Google Artifact Registry

evidence.claim: No registry is recorded and Workload Identity is not enabled.

candidates.decision_rationale: Nothing recorded to build on; revisit if images must be private.

candidates.name: Kustomize manifests in this repo with one Argo CD Application

evidence.claim: Argo CD v3.6.1 is installed with no repository, Application or AppProject.

risks: Argo CD has no repository connected; connecting one is an operator-approved action.
Image tag promotion needs a pull request, an image updater or a CI commit.
candidates.decision_rationale: Pull-based delivery from a public repo; no cluster credential stored in GitHub.

candidates.name: kubectl apply from GitHub Actions

evidence.claim: Authenticates with a service-account key held as a GitHub secret, then applies manifests file by file.

risks: Long-lived cluster credential in GitHub.
candidates.decision_rationale: Fallback if Argo CD cannot be connected.

candidates.name: conduit Gateway, Certificate and HTTPRoute manifests

evidence.claim: Gateway with gatewayClassName eg, HTTPS 443 and HTTP 80 listeners, a Certificate, an HTTPS HTTPRoute and an HTTP redirect route.

risks: Written for a different cluster (client-cluster); issuer and class names must be verified on the target.
candidates.decision_rationale: Same gateway class and issuer naming as the target baseline.

candidates.name: Gateway API ResponseHeaderModifier

evidence.claim: Envoy Gateway supports the HTTPRoute ResponseHeaderModifier filter.
buildContentSecurityPolicyHeader() exists for hosted serving and is called by no server.

risks: Permissions-Policy must allow camera and microphone for this origin.
candidates.decision_rationale: Headers set once, as response headers, in a reviewed manifest generated from the existing CSP builder.

candidates.name: Operator-created Kubernetes Secret (value on stdin)

evidence.claim: Recorded pattern for this cluster: pipe the value into kubectl create secret ... --from-file=key=/dev/stdin.

risks: Manual rotation.
Not restored from Git if the cluster is rebuilt.
candidates.decision_rationale: No secret enters the repo, image or CI. Sufficient for one secret.

candidates.name: Sealed Secrets

evidence.claim: gh api: Apache-2.0, pushed 2026-11-10.

candidates.decision_rationale: Next step when more than one secret is managed through Git. Installation not researched.

candidates.name: livekit-examples/meet

evidence.claim: The organisation holds a fork: video conferencing on LiveKit Components, LiveKit Cloud and Next.js.

candidates.decision_rationale: Different framework. Read for lobby and pre-join flow only.

candidates.name: Playwright two-context meeting check with fake media devices

evidence.claim: Playwright is already configured in the repo.

risks: Chromium fake-device flags are not set in playwright.config.ts today and were not verified against the pinned @playwright/test 1.65.0; verify early in the plan, with an agent-run machine with real devices as fallback.
The check drives the public token endpoint of the built or deployed service, so the test runner never holds the LiveKit secret. It still uses LiveKit Cloud minutes.
candidates.decision_rationale: Automated proof of the user operation against the real service and the deployed URL.

candidates.name: tower_governor

evidence.claim: cargo search: tower_governor 0.8.0, a rate-limiting middleware for Tower backed by the governor crate.

risks: Only the registry listing was read; Axum 0.8 compatibility, key extraction behind a proxy and licence are unverified.
candidates.decision_rationale: Candidate for the per-IP rate limit on the token endpoint. Evaluate at spec time before hand-rolling. Behind the Gateway the client address comes from a forwarded header, which the limiter must be configured to trust correctly.

candidates.name: scripts/build-site.sh, publish-pages.sh, publish-ipfs.sh

evidence.claim: Stages docs/design (brand kit and static prototype) for GitHub Pages and IPFS; does not build or publish apps/web.

candidates.decision_rationale: They publish the design site to static hosts with no server side. The release needs a token service and a cluster, so they are not the delivery path.
